gen-gf-bellota-gf-varta: Bellota's s hangs its ends far out from the spine, and every stroke is traced as if by one stylus, never pinching at a curve. Varta follows in sans-serif, its big open eyes on e and a keeping paragraphs easy.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-vazirmatn: Vazirmatn reads friendly and modern, its wide s never tightening up as the lines pile on. Bellota heads it with full-width strokes where you might expect hairline joins, so the whole thing flows steadily.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-wix-madefor-display: Bellota looks drawn with a marker tip, every letter one confident line. Wix Madefor Display, a plain sans with gently flared curve ends that stay apart, keeps a long run of text smooth and unhurried.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-wix-madefor-text: Bellota opens the pair with no vertical emphasis and no thinning anywhere. It is best at announcing a line with that bold, uniform stroke, while Wix Madefor Text, a sans-serif with open terminals, is best at being read comfortably.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ysabeau-infant: Round, bold and uncomplicated: Bellota has no pinched joins and no swelling bowls. Ysabeau Infant, a sans-serif with terminals pointing outward like tongs, takes over where Bellota's showy headline job ends and the steady reading begins.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ysabeau-office: Distinctive is the first word for Bellota, a true monoline drawing. Ysabeau Office, a plain sans with open-ended curves, sits below it and lets the heading's odd s do the talking while the text stays modern and quiet.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ysabeau-sc: Ysabeau SC, a plain sans with a visibly gaping c at any size, carries a professional, modern tone. Bellota is best at making a bold, level statement with no accents of weight, whereas the body does the patient everyday work.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-zalando-sans: Zalando Sans sets an approachable tone with open curves on every rounded letter. Bellota is best at standing out with its unshaded, constant strokes, and the sans body is best at staying out of the way.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Clean, in a wide-set way: Bellota's single track width looks like neon sign tubing. Zalando Sans Expanded, a sans-serif with sparse letters and c tips that never creep toward touching, makes a long stretch feel spacious and slow.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpan: Tube-like strokes, wide-hanging s. Bellota runs stems and arcs in lockstep, and below it Zalando Sans SemiExpanded, a plain sans with open-mouthed curves on c, e and s, reads modern and smooth over a long stretch.
